entries.title: Privacy-safe telemetry and change-impact drift gate
entries.trigger: WP09 requires correlated operations evidence without chat content leakage and requires documentation drift to fail CI.
entries.telemetry_change: Adds a local record validator only; no sink, network export, user content, token text, attachment content, session ID or user ID is collected.
entries.rollback: Revert the additive telemetry, checker, tests, workflow/template wiring, manifest entry and records; no API, DB, runtime route or production flag changes.
